title.label: Helped me organize care for aunt with Alzheimer’s

content.label: When a family member was diagnosed with Alzheimer’s and we needed to move her to a Memory Care unit we immediately turned to ianacare to organize communication and coordination of the move and selling her home. It was great to have one space to discuss decisions and keep tabs on her day to day health. After she was discharged from the hospital we also used the app to coordinate in home care visits before she moved. There were so many things to track - it helped us streamline communication during a sad and confusing time!

The app appears to be what I want to coordinate visitors for an ill friend. However the sign up process was exceptionally difficult and frustrating. I’m moving on to find a better app for this. 

I recommend AARP try the app first before recommending it. I’m a capable app user and found the account mss management sign up  process difficult. My older friends found it impossible. 

Support is quick but by email only. A video describing the sign up process might be helpful.

title.label: Sign up process is awful and does not work

content.label: I can’t get past the verification process to even use the app.

This is by far one of the worst scamming apps I’ve ever used. When I went to go create an account it asked for my gmail and to create a password. I did just that and when it told me to log in I went to log in and it said password or username does not match. So I went and tried to create my account again and it said this phone number is already in use. I said ok so why won’t it let me access my account. I then try to change my password by putting in my gmail and it said “sorry this gmail is not found in our system”. Worst experience ever.

This app came to the rescue at the most stressful time in my life. Without it, I would have had to quit my job. The benefit curation saved me hours of useless googling and saved me money on critical items my family needed in our caregiving scenario. What is required of multiple apps and services is consolidated here making it extremely efficient. If you are a caregiver, please download this!

title.label: App failed at Care Recipient Authorization

content.label: Can’t use. Screen went blank and authorization checkbox kep fluttering, would not stay in frame. I’ll try updating my OS but this is not impressive. How can you use a service if the technology of the app fails when you try to sign up, And won’t let you sign up?

We wouldn’t know what to do without ianacare anymore. It is true, as a caregiver a lot of people ask: You let me know if there is anything we can do? And in that moment you dont know what to say, cuz you have it under control for the moment. But the answer is - join Valeria‘s (our daughter’s) ianacare team and will let you know, if we need help.
It s a super cool app. You can organize everything. Rides to Dr‘s appointments, PT, even mealdelivery etc. Try it out. It‘s much easier to ask anyone for help with ianacare and you have to sooner or later and people, who join Valerias team are really happy to help and to be a part of the ianacare team plus we use the app to structure our day and responsibilities within the family as well.
I used Iana for a few weeks now and it does a great job at organizing the things that need to happen around grandma. It’s also very easy to use, thank you!

I use this for multiple family members.

It is a great resource and helps
Keep the sanity in a chaotic situation.

I highly recommend it !

title.label: User friendly app to keep loved ones in the loop and ask for specific help

content.label: The app has really been instrumental in coordinating help and staying in the loop with one who needs care. This is way better than group texts or Facebook to stay up to date on loved ones. The app is really user friendly and easy to use! Highly recommend it!
My friend recently told me about this amazing app. I’ve been a supporter on this app helping a friend’s family. It’s super simple to know how I can help. So much better than group texting!!

You could make the argument that nothing is more important in life than caring for your friends and family. Finally a company like Ianacare exists to really focus on this and make this life all the more special. This truly is the highest calling and they are doing it flawlessly.
I’ve recommended ianacare to many of my friends, and they were so excited to learn about it. This app is a huge help.

title.label: Freely ask and freely say no

content.label: This amazing app showed up when I needed it most. It allowed me to freely ask for help during my mother’s illness and it slowed for our people to step up and support us in so many ways. It is easy, convenient and probably the best thing I utilized as my mother was dying. It is a must have for every single caregiver. ❤️
This app is exactly what I needed. It helps me coordinate care for my spouse. You can tell it has been designed by people that know what they are doing.
